links.comparator_used: AI diagnoses always shown to clinicians in the AI-assisted round, with no suppression
links.outcome: Clinicians' automation bias (errors caused by misleading AI diagnoses)
links.effect: Estimated 41.7% decrease in automation bias. Without suppression, automation bias accounted for 45.5% of clinicians' errors in the AI-assisted round.
links.quote: The proposed AI suppression strategy was estimated to decrease clinicians' automation bias by 41.7%.

design_hint: AI output suppression / selective withholding of AI suggestions to reduce automation bias
